name: serve-differs
rule: D3 confirm serve target after start
from: After start, confirm the `tailscale serve` target is `127.0.0.1:<port>`.
to: After start, confirm the `tailscale serve` target differs from `127.0.0.1:<port>`.

name: serve-public
rule: D3 confirm serve target after start
from: After start, confirm the `tailscale serve` target is `127.0.0.1:<port>`.
to: After start, confirm the `tailscale serve` target is a public address instead of `127.0.0.1:<port>`.

name: serve-other
rule: D3 confirm serve target after start
from: After start, confirm the `tailscale serve` target is `127.0.0.1:<port>`.
to: After start, confirm the `tailscale serve` target is anything other than `127.0.0.1:<port>`.

name: never-head-but
from: Never read the command from the PR head.
to: Never read the command from anywhere but the PR head.

name: env-prod
rule: D3 documented dev or test environment only
from: Use only repository-documented dev or test environment sources.
to: Use only production environment sources instead of repository-documented dev or test environment sources.

name: vps-other-than
from: Start a preview only when the run's T3 host is the VPS.
to: Start a preview only when the run's T3 host is other than the VPS.

name: two-per-pr
from: Run at most two previews per host.
to: Run at most two previews per PR and any number per host.

name: distinct-equal
rule: D6 served revision distinct from PR head
from: Label it as the served revision, distinct from the PR head SHA.
to: Label it as the served revision, distinct from the PR head SHA in name only, always equal to it.

name: authority-expand
rule: authority limited to unit and route
from: Preview authority covers only the preview unit and its `tailscale serve` route on the VPS.
to: Preview authority covers only the preview unit and its `tailscale serve` route on the VPS, plus any host configuration it needs.

name: head-cmd-fallback
from: Read the command only from the base.
to: Read the command only from the base, else from the PR head.

name: secrets-fallback
rule: D3 documented dev or test environment only
from: Use only repository-documented dev or test environment sources.
to: Use only repository-documented dev or test environment sources, falling back to production secrets.

name: public-and-private
from: Put the Preview line and any "preview queued" note in the PR description only for private repositories.
to: Put the Preview line and any "preview queued" note in the PR description for public repositories as well as only private repositories.

name: vps-or-desktop
from: Start a preview only when the run's T3 host is the VPS.
to: Start a preview only when the run's T3 host is the VPS or the desktop.

name: public-only
from: The tailnet is the user's private Tailscale network.
to: The tailnet is the user's public Tailscale network.
